messages:
Emma S: Quick question — ACME post-trial: final sweep & access rotation for their environment (Dedicated pool rp-ACME01 + VPC). Who's taking ownership for keys/pool teardown and ensuring logs/export before we delete?

Raj P: I'll own the pool teardown. Need confirmation on retention/export window from security/legal.

Lina C: From compliance: default retention 30d. ACME requested 90d. We agreed to 90d only for non-PII logs. If PII exists we must escalate to legal. Emma, do we have a sample dataset to check?

Emma S: We have a small dev snapshot in s3://acme-poc-exports/dev-sample.csv — it's redacted but let's treat as PII until verified.

Tom R: Plan: 1) Revoke hosted API keys 2) Drain dedicated pool 3) Export traces/logs to S3 4) Teardown pool 5) Rotate KMS keys 6) Confirm backups removed. I can run steps 2-4.

Miguel B: Add note: for Dedicated pools we should also detach autoscaler hooks and remove DNS entries in VPC peering before deletion.

Tom R: Commands (run from ops bastion):
```
# revoke api key
redwoodctl keys revoke --key-id key-acme-demo

# export logs
redwoodctl export logs --pool rp-ACME01 --dest s3://acme-poc-exports/exports-$(date +%F)

# drain pool
redwoodctl pools drain --pool-id rp-ACME01 --timeout 1800

# delete pool
redwoodctl pools delete --pool-id rp-ACME01 --confirm
```

Raj P: Note: run `--scrub` for export if potential PII: `redwoodctl export logs --scrub`

Lina C: We also need a signed data disposal statement from ACME before we formally delete raw exports. Who's getting signed doc?

Emma S: I'll get legal to send the DSAR/disposal form. ETA EOD today.

deploy-bot: pool rp-ACME01 drain initiated by Tom R at 1857502501

Tom R: Drain complete. No active jobs. Starting export now.

deploy-bot: export job 42 completed, files at s3://acme-poc-exports/exports-2026-03-21/

Miguel B: After export and signed disposal, rotate KMS keys: `kms rotate --key alias/acme-poc` then revoke old key material.

Lina C: Confirm retention policy set to 90d for exported logs and that S3 bucket has lifecycle to delete after 365d unless legal requests hold.

Emma S: Legal signed disposal doc received. Attaching in thread: (link) https://internal.docs/acme/disposal/signed.pdf

Raj P: I'm going to revoke Hosted API keys now in Console and post confirmation.

Raj P: Done. API key key-acme-demo revoked :white_check_mark:

Tom R: Deleting pool now.

deploy-bot: pool rp-ACME01 delete started at 1857502560

deploy-bot: pool rp-ACME01 delete completed at 1857502588

Emma S: Confirming steps are done. Team — please thumbs up if you have no outstanding items. :thumbsup:

All: :thumbsup:
